account:
Today appears to be an ordinary working day so far; I have not witnessed anything clearly suspicious. During my morning office business, the builder asked which repairs the town would authorize and what budget and payment were available. I requested an inspection and itemized proposal for bridge and road repairs before approving spending, but the builder may not have heard that request: the secretary, rather than the builder, was within hearing when I gave it. I should not assume the inspection or a 16:30 meeting is confirmed.

The secretary reviewed my appointments and offered to identify the host and precise location of my three o'clock dockside tea. At the market, the neighbour personally confirmed that they are hosting our usual tea at the east-bank cottage, road point (16, -60, 105). That resolves the location uncertainty; I have not yet told the secretary.

Townsfolk reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the bridge and market. I did not witness that myself. Later I heard an indistinct distant shout and went to the bakery stall to check. The baker said everything was fine and that the shout was simply advertising fresh bread. They reported eight emeralds in sales and a well-stocked stall, and asked whether upcoming municipal meals or gatherings would need bread. I know of none and made no order or spending commitment. This seems consistent with normal bread sales and deliveries, not evidence of wrongdoing. I also saw freight near the stall holding an emerald, but do not know their business or what their later conversation concerned.

I have now reached my home road point at 12:07 for my scheduled noon lunch. Next are office accounts at 13:00, tea at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00.
